title: About Minhaajulhudaa Masjid

content.title: About Us
content.subtitle: A center for prayer, learning, and community

content.body: Minhaajulhudaa Masjid was established in 2020 to serve the growing Muslim community in Lagos. Our masjid provides a spiritual home for daily prayers, Jumu'ah, Taraweeh during Ramadan, and a center for Islamic learning and community activities.

With a capacity of 2,000 worshippers, our facility includes a main prayer hall, sisters' section, wudu areas, classrooms for Islamic education, a library, and administrative offices. We are committed to following the Qur'an and Sunnah in all our affairs.

seoDescription: Learn about Minhaajulhudaa Masjid - serving the community since 2020.
